topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't stop thinking about what you told me, about someone using your art, making it a permanent part of their skin. It's so... intense. I mean, it’s an honor, right? But it’s also this huge statement, like they’re carrying a piece of you everywhere they go. I don't know, it just feels overwhelming. What if they don’t fully understand what it means, what it took to create? I just hope it doesn’t end up feeling like a violation, you know? I wish there was a way to talk to them, to explain, to make sure your work is respected. You shouldn’t have to feel this way, with something so personal being so... out there.
